failure: No-notch exterior control falsely localized an indentation.

assessment.cause: O3L2 multiplied boundary evidence by exterior similarity but left that similarity as a soft score. A sufficiently strong internal periodic transition could remain eligible even when the pixels below it did not closely match the measured exterior.
assessment.prevention: Make sustained exterior likeness below the candidate a hard boundary eligibility condition before dynamic tracing, while retaining the unchanged minimum notch depth and ambiguity controls.
